tickets.title: Review equity award strategy
tickets.text: Use this workflow to evaluate Nia and Owen Bramblequill's equity compensation package, identify tax and concentration risks, and prepare planning recommendations before the next compensation decision window. Gather current grant documents, vesting schedules, cost basis information, estimated income, and any employer plan rules before completing the review. Prepare a charitable funding comparison of appreciated employer shares versus cash gifts to support the $250,000 fund goal, incorporating tax impact and portfolio concentration considerations.

subTasks.title: Collect equity award evidence
subTasks.text: Request grant agreements, vesting schedules, recent brokerage statements, employer plan summaries, and any prior exercise or sale confirmations. Confirm award types, vesting status, expiration timing, and blackout or trading-window constraints.

subTasks.title: Analyze tax and cash-flow impact
subTasks.text: Model potential ordinary income, capital gain, AMT exposure where applicable, withholding gaps, and estimated tax needs. Note whether charitable giving, tax-loss harvesting, or staged sales may be relevant.

subTasks.title: Assess concentration and liquidity risk
subTasks.text: Compare employer stock exposure with the client's total portfolio, spending needs, emergency reserves, and upcoming liquidity events. Document recommended diversification ranges and any constraints on execution.

subTasks.title: Prepare recommendation summary
subTasks.text: Create a concise client-facing summary with available choices, planning tradeoffs, documents reviewed, open questions, and recommended next steps for the advisor meeting.

tickets.evidence: They agreed to prepare the comparison by December 12, 2025.
